scripts.build:android: VITE_BASE=./ vite build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:ios: VITE_BASE=./ vite build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android:apk: VITE_BASE=./ vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:apk:debug: VITE_BASE=./ vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:archive: VITE_BASE=./ vite build && npx cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive
